描述_EN: the flyknit technology allows nike designers to micro-engineer every stitch of the shoe’s upper, scientifically tuned to meet the exact specifications of athletes. the vapormax sole was designed to allow nike to create air bubbles in the sole without having to have a secondary layer of rubber and foam. after five years of development and 195 rounds of adjustments, trainers made with the new technology were first worn at the 2012 olympics by somalia-american long-distance runner abdi abdirahman. nike began working on ‘flyknit’ technology in 2007. it features an upper knit with a super-light, strong fabric, without the weighty structure of traditional shoe making. the pattern is created via a computer program, which allows for infinite subtle, immediate and specific customisation. it is also a far more sustainable method of manufacture than conventional trainer production as instead of cutting irregular shapes from a rectangular cloth, each flyknit upper is knitted exactly to size resulting in very minimal waste. these vapormax flyknit trainers combine two key developments by nike designers in one trainer. this gives greater flexibility and spring without compromising on structure, while also reducing weight and waste.
描述_ZN: Flyknit技术允许耐克设计师对鞋面的每一个缝隙进行微观设计，科学地调整以满足运动员的确切规格。 vapormax鞋底的设计是为了让耐克在鞋底产生气泡，而不需要有第二层的橡胶和泡沫。 经过五年的开发和195轮的调整，采用新技术的训练鞋在2012年奥运会上首次由索马里-美国长跑运动员Abdi Abdirahman穿着。 耐克在2007年开始研究 "flyknit "技术。 它的特点是用超轻、坚固的织物编织鞋面，没有传统制鞋的沉重结构。 它的图案是通过计算机程序创建的，可以进行无限细微、即时和具体的定制。 它也是一种比传统训练器生产更可持续的制造方法，因为不是从矩形布上切割出不规则的形状，每个flyknit鞋面都是完全按照尺寸编织的，导致浪费非常少。 这些vapormax flyknit训练器在一个训练器中结合了耐克设计师的两个关键发展。 这在不影响结构的情况下提供了更大的灵活性和弹簧，同时也减少了重量和浪费。
